answer: The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, re-queued for a second panel, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Work waits on the signal until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the island of the next round. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. By the nadir of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
